name: Order confirmation
subject: Order KW-20418 is confirmed
preheader: Thanks, Jamie. We roast your coffee on Tuesday and post it on Wednesday morning.
summary: Sent when an order is paid. Lists the items, the totals and where the order is going.

footer.reason: You are getting this email because you placed an order with Kettlewick. It is a service message, so it arrives even if you have left the Roast notes list.

order.delivery: Standard post, 2 to 3 working days after posting

help: Need a different grind? Reply before 8am on Tuesday and we will change it before roasting.
handles: Line items in a real data table with column and row headers, so a screen reader can follow it
Line totals, the discount and the total worked out at build time from unit prices, then checked again by the tests
Delivery and payment details in two fluid hybrid columns that stack on phones without a media query
Ghost tables in Outlook conditional comments keep those columns side by side in Outlook
Thumbnails sized by width and height attributes, so Outlook on a high DPI screen keeps them at 56 pixels
Figures right aligned with tabular numbers
